bad_guidance.why: Type-scale-and-roles advice on a keyboard-operability review with change_budget 'low' and typography a preserved slot. It entered only because table.tabular_figures was marked critical, taking half a 2-record bundle from the uncovered 'accessibility' and 'component' concerns.

guidance_ignored.why: Typography is a preserved slot at change_budget 'low'; the project inherits the WinUI type ramp and its numeric style already sets Typography.NumeralAlignment=Tabular. Generating a new scale would be an unjustified change on a keyboard-operability task.

process_records_reason: SKILL.md §2 (reuse -> extend -> compose -> new) and §7 (render and inspect) were enough; the sibling StockAdjustmentsPage is a stronger reuse signal than any record. Noted: process.reuse_first was reported as 'not surfaced', and reuse was the decision that shaped the implementation.

misses.what: table.tabular_figures marked critical for a keyboard-operability review; not a keyboard concept, and it is why a GENERIC typography record occupies half the bundle.
a11y-keyboard-operable (top-ranked record for this exact sentence in `search`, 0.45) and a11y-labels-names / a11y-native-semantics never entered the bundle; a11y.accessible_names left uncovered.
interaction.selection_visible, interaction.menu_semantics and a11y.dialog_focus never demanded for a keyboard review of a desktop table screen.
Shell navigation detected as 'menu-bar'; the app is a NavigationView left rail. Propagated into requirements, the direction's navigation slot (nav-menu-bar-desktop) and the fingerprint.
screen: [] — 'invoice matching page' produced no screen classification, so every table / master-detail record was omitted for 'no positive task evidence' on a screen that is two tables.

regressions.query: Review the supplier invoice matching page for keyboard operability.
regressions.expect: Bundle contains a11y-keyboard-operable or a11y-labels-names and covers a11y.accessible_names; table.tabular_figures is not critical for an interaction/keyboard review and typo-scale-and-roles does not enter the bundle.

regressions.query: keyboard or screen-reader review sentence naming a desktop table/grid screen
regressions.expect: interaction.selection_visible, interaction.menu_semantics and a11y.dialog_focus are demanded as expected concepts.

regressions.query: inspect_project on a WinUI/WPF project whose shell is a NavigationView with NavigationViewItems
regressions.expect: design_context.navigation = left-rail, not menu-bar; page-level CommandBar/MenuFlyout hits must not outweigh shell navigation evidence.
